name: Night Neon
description: The current look: dark navy rooms, a glowing cyan player and violet echoes, all drawn in code.

name: Pixel Meadow
description: Bright pixel art: earth and grass tiles, a sky with clouds and trees, a little astronaut whose echoes are pink copies.

name: Toybox Shapes
description: Chunky flat toy shapes: blue zig-zag floors, red lock blocks for gates, a round blue character with green echoes, rounded Fredoka type.

name: Green Terminal
description: Retro computer screen: 1-bit sprites in green phosphor, scanlines and a vignette, VT323 terminal font, chip-style sounds.
